showOnHomepage.description: Whether to show this service on the homepage

status.description: Publication status. Left out keeps the current one (a new service starts as a draft); changing it needs the publish permission

translations.description: Translations, one per language. Those with a non-empty title are created or updated; languages that are not sent are left as they are. At least one needs a title

title.description: Service title. A translation with an empty title is skipped, not saved

description.description: Short description; left out or null clears it

content.description: Rich text content (sanitised on save); left out or null clears it

metaTitle.description: SEO meta title (empty or null clears it)

metaDescription.description: SEO meta description (empty or null clears it)

projectIds.description: IDs of the assigned projects in display order (replaces the existing ones)

version.description: The `version` of the record the change is based on (from its detail). When another one is stored, nothing is written and the answer is 409 with the code VERSION_CONFLICT. Left out, the change is written without the check
